title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30429: add events to disambiguate CRM integration table mappings
summary: Four integration events are added to allow extensions to select the correct CRM integration table mapping when multiple mappings share the same table ID, enabling proper disambiguation in order-status updates, coupling, uncoupling, and match-based coupling scenarios.
key_points: Four new IntegrationEvent publishers added: OnUpdateSalesOrdersOnBeforeFindIntegrationTableMapping, OnAfterInitialize, OnRemoveCouplingOnBeforeGetIntegrationTableMappingForUncoupling, OnMatchBasedCouplingOnBeforeGetIntegrationTableMappingForMatchBasedCoupling
Events use read-only RecordRef parameters to allow subscribers to inspect source records without mutating caller state
Addresses scenario where extensions have multiple same-table mappings (e.g., Sales Header quotes alongside standard orders)
Thin event publishers marked with [IntegrationEvent(false, false)]
Enables correct mapping resolution during CRM sync operations
